title: Audio-Visual Turn-taking Prediction in Cocktail Party Scenarios
title_zh: 鸡尾酒会场景中的音视听轮次转换预测
abstract_en: Current predictive turn-taking models (PTTMs) achieve strong performance on benchmarks with controlled acoustic conditions and clean audio signals. Their generalisation to conversations with overlapping speech and background interference remains underexplored. In this research, we evaluate audio-visual PTTMs trained with clean data on a challenging cocktail-party testbed derived from the AVCocktail dataset, and analyse their adaptation behaviour to this new domain. Experimental results show consistent performance degradation across audio and visual modalities under noisy conditions, with up to 38% relative drop in weighted F1. Fine-tuning on the new domain improves robustness, but gains vary across modalities and depend on the size of the available pre-training data. These findings provide insights into the different generalisation and adaptation capabilities of the audio and visual modalities, and indicate the need for robust modelling strategies to adapt to the complexities of human interactions in noise. All code and turn labels are made publicly available to facilitate further research.
abstract_zh: 现有预测式轮次转换模型（Predictive Turn-Taking Models, PTTMs）在声学条件受控、音频信号干净的基准上表现出色，但其在语音重叠和背景干扰条件下的泛化能力仍缺乏研究。本文基于 AVCocktail 数据集构建具有挑战性的鸡尾酒会测试平台，评估使用干净数据训练的音视听 PTTMs，并分析模型适应新领域时的表现。实验结果表明，在噪声条件下，音频与视觉模态的性能均持续下降，加权 F1 的相对降幅最高达 38%。在新领域上进行微调能够提升模型鲁棒性，但不同模态的收益存在差异，且取决于可用预训练数据的规模。研究揭示了音频与视觉模态在泛化和适应能力上的差别，表明需要更鲁棒的建模策略，以应对噪声环境中人类交互的复杂性。作者公开了全部代码与轮次标签，以促进后续研究。
key_points_zh: 基于 AVCocktail 构建鸡尾酒会测试平台，考察干净数据训练的音视听 PTTMs 在语音重叠与背景干扰下的泛化能力。
噪声条件会同时削弱音频和视觉模态，模型加权 F1 的相对降幅最高达到 38%。
在目标噪声领域上进行微调可以增强鲁棒性，但提升幅度因模态而异。
模型的领域适应收益与预训练数据规模相关，说明音频和视觉模态具有不同的泛化及适应特性。
论文已被 IEEE SLT 2026 接收，并公开代码、轮次标签及经人工核验的 AVCocktail 标签。

llm_assessment.comment: This study addresses a practical audio-visual turn-taking bottleneck under noisy overlapping speech, though its contribution is more diagnostic than architecturally transformative.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 该研究聚焦噪声与重叠语音下的视听轮次预测瓶颈，但贡献更偏向诊断分析而非架构革新。
